Ethiopia and Eritrea each accused the other of starting a war of aggression

Ethiopia and Eritrea each formally accused the other on October 9 of waging a war of aggression, with a foreign security source estimating 5,000 to 8,000 Eritrean troops inside northern Tigray. Eritrean Information Minister Yemane Gebremeskel said Eritrea faces “an unprovoked war of aggression” from Ethiopia.
